asked.question: Which algorithm is best for time-series data? (CNN / RNN / DNN / ANN)
Which ML model employs backpropagation? (MLP / CNN / RNN / All of the above)
ANN এবং BNN এর তুলনা করুন।

Imagine a government agency is developing an Al-based citizen service chatbot that can automatically generate responses, summarize documents, and provide policy information to citizens. Explain how Generative Al can be used to power such a system, and how Explainable Al (XAI) techniques can ensure that its response are transparent, reliable, and accountable [Combined Bank Officer (IT) 25] (10 Marks)
b) Briefly discuss Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) and "Large Language Models (LLMs)".
(c) What is activation function in Deep Neural Network? What is the usability of this?
What is agentive AI? Compare it with traditional chatbot AI.

mustKnow.en: Machine Learning (ML): a subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed. Types: Supervised learning (labelled data), Unsupervised learning (unlabelled data), Reinforcement learning (reward signals).
mustKnow.bn: Machine Learning (ML): AI-এর একটি subset যেখানে systems explicitly programmed না হয়ে data থেকে patterns শেখে। Types: Supervised learning (labelled data), Unsupervised learning (unlabelled data), Reinforcement learning (reward signals)।

mustKnow.en: Artificial Neural Network (ANN): a computational model inspired by biological neurons. Consists of layers: Input layer, Hidden layer(s), Output layer. Each connection has a weight; training adjusts weights via backpropagation.
mustKnow.bn: Artificial Neural Network (ANN): biological neurons দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত একটি computational model। Layers নিয়ে গঠিত: Input layer, Hidden layer(s), Output layer। প্রতিটি connection-এ একটি weight আছে; training backpropagation দিয়ে weights সামঞ্জস্য করে।

mustKnow.en: Deep Learning: ML using neural networks with many hidden layers (deep neural networks). Excels at unstructured data: images (CNN), text/sequences (RNN/LSTM/Transformer), audio. Requires large datasets and GPUs.
mustKnow.bn: Deep Learning: অনেক hidden layers (deep neural networks) সহ neural networks ব্যবহার করে ML। Unstructured data-তে ভালো: images (CNN), text/sequences (RNN/LSTM/Transformer), audio। Large datasets ও GPUs প্রয়োজন।

mustKnow.en: Activation function: a non-linear function applied at each neuron to introduce non-linearity. Without it, stacked layers reduce to one linear transformation. Common: Sigmoid (0-1, binary classification), ReLU (max(0,x), most popular), Tanh (-1 to 1), Softmax (multiclass output).
mustKnow.bn: Activation function: non-linearity introduce করতে প্রতিটি neuron-এ applied non-linear function। এটি ছাড়া, stacked layers একটি linear transformation-এ পরিণত হয়। Common: Sigmoid (0-1, binary classification), ReLU (max(0,x), সবচেয়ে জনপ্রিয়), Tanh (-1 to 1), Softmax (multiclass output)।

mustKnow.en: Backpropagation: the training algorithm for neural networks. Calculates the gradient of the loss function with respect to each weight using the chain rule, then updates weights via gradient descent to minimize error.
mustKnow.bn: Backpropagation: neural networks-এর training algorithm। Chain rule ব্যবহার করে প্রতিটি weight-এর সাপেক্ষে loss function-এর gradient গণনা করে, তারপর error minimize করতে gradient descent দিয়ে weights update করে।

mustKnow.en: CNN (Convolutional Neural Network): deep learning architecture for image data. Key layers: Convolutional (detects features), Pooling (reduces dimensions), Fully connected (classification). Used in: image recognition, object detection, face recognition.
mustKnow.bn: CNN (Convolutional Neural Network): image data-র জন্য deep learning architecture। Key layers: Convolutional (features detect করে), Pooling (dimensions কমায়), Fully connected (classification)। ব্যবহৃত হয়: image recognition, object detection, face recognition-এ।

mustKnow.en: RNN (Recurrent Neural Network): deep learning for sequential/time-series data. Has memory — output from previous step feeds into current step. Best for: time-series forecasting, NLP, speech recognition. LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) and GRU solve the vanishing gradient problem in basic RNNs.
mustKnow.bn: RNN (Recurrent Neural Network): sequential/time-series data-র জন্য deep learning। Memory আছে — আগের step-এর output বর্তমান step-এ feed করে। সেরা: time-series forecasting, NLP, speech recognition। LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) ও GRU basic RNNs-এর vanishing gradient problem সমাধান করে।

mustKnow.en: Transformer architecture: the foundation of modern AI (BERT, GPT, LLaMA). Uses self-attention mechanism — relates all positions in a sequence to each other simultaneously. Replaced RNNs for most NLP tasks due to parallelisability.
mustKnow.bn: Transformer architecture: আধুনিক AI-এর ভিত্তি (BERT, GPT, LLaMA)। Self-attention mechanism ব্যবহার করে — sequence-এর সব positions একসঙ্গে একে অপরের সাথে সম্পর্কিত করে। Parallelisability-এর কারণে বেশিরভাগ NLP tasks-এর জন্য RNNs-কে প্রতিস্থাপন করেছে।

mustKnow.en: Large Language Model (LLM): a neural network (typically Transformer-based) trained on massive text datasets to understand and generate human language. Examples: GPT-4 (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Claude (Anthropic), LLaMA (Meta). Used for: chatbots, code generation, summarisation, translation.
mustKnow.bn: Large Language Model (LLM): human language বোঝার এবং তৈরি করার জন্য massive text datasets-এ trained একটি neural network (সাধারণত Transformer-based)। উদাহরণ: GPT-4 (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Claude (Anthropic), LLaMA (Meta)। ব্যবহৃত হয়: chatbots, code generation, summarisation, translation-এ।

mustKnow.en: Generative AI: AI that creates new content — text (LLMs), images (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E), audio, video, code. Core models: GANs (Generator + Discriminator), Diffusion models (add then remove noise), Transformers (LLMs). Key use cases: content creation, drug discovery, synthetic data.
mustKnow.bn: Generative AI: নতুন content তৈরি করে এমন AI — text (LLMs), images (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E), audio, video, code। Core models: GANs (Generator + Discriminator), Diffusion models (noise যোগ করে তারপর সরায়), Transformers (LLMs)। Key use cases: content creation, drug discovery, synthetic data।

mustKnow.en: GAN (Generative Adversarial Network): two networks — Generator (creates fake data) and Discriminator (distinguishes real from fake). Trained together: Generator tries to fool Discriminator; Discriminator improves detection. Used for: image synthesis, deepfakes, style transfer.
mustKnow.bn: GAN (Generative Adversarial Network): দুটি networks — Generator (fake data তৈরি করে) এবং Discriminator (real থেকে fake পার্থক্য করে)। একসঙ্গে trained: Generator Discriminator-কে ফাঁকি দেওয়ার চেষ্টা করে; Discriminator detection উন্নত করে। ব্যবহৃত হয়: image synthesis, deepfakes, style transfer-এ।

mustKnow.en: Prompt engineering: the practice of designing inputs (prompts) to guide LLMs to produce desired outputs. Techniques: zero-shot (no examples), few-shot (a few examples), chain-of-thought (step-by-step reasoning), role prompting.
mustKnow.bn: Prompt engineering: desired outputs তৈরিতে LLMs guide করতে inputs (prompts) ডিজাইন করার practice। Techniques: zero-shot (কোনো উদাহরণ নেই), few-shot (কয়েকটি উদাহরণ), chain-of-thought (step-by-step reasoning), role prompting।

mustKnow.en: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): enhances LLMs by retrieving relevant documents from a knowledge base before generating a response. Reduces hallucination, enables up-to-date answers without retraining. Architecture: query → retriever → relevant docs → LLM → answer.
mustKnow.bn: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): response তৈরির আগে knowledge base থেকে relevant documents retrieve করে LLMs উন্নত করে। Hallucination কমায়, retraining ছাড়া up-to-date answers সক্ষম করে। Architecture: query → retriever → relevant docs → LLM → answer।

mustKnow.en: AI Hallucination: when an AI model generates plausible-sounding but factually incorrect or fabricated information. Common in LLMs. Causes: training data gaps, pattern completion without verification. Mitigation: RAG, fine-tuning, fact-checking, confidence scores.
mustKnow.bn: AI Hallucination: AI model যখন plausible-sounding কিন্তু factually incorrect বা fabricated তথ্য তৈরি করে। LLMs-এ সাধারণ। কারণ: training data gaps, verification ছাড়া pattern completion। Mitigation: RAG, fine-tuning, fact-checking, confidence scores।

mustKnow.en: Explainable AI (XAI): techniques to make AI decisions transparent and interpretable. Methods: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), saliency maps. Critical for healthcare, finance, legal, and public-sector AI.
mustKnow.bn: Explainable AI (XAI): AI decisions transparent ও interpretable করার techniques। Methods: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations), SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), saliency maps। Healthcare, finance, legal এবং public-sector AI-এর জন্য critical।

mustKnow.en: Agentic AI: AI systems that autonomously perceive their environment, plan multi-step actions, use tools (web search, code execution, APIs), and achieve goals with minimal human intervention. vs Traditional chatbot: rule-based, single-turn, no memory, no tools.
mustKnow.bn: Agentic AI: AI systems যা স্বায়ত্তশাসিতভাবে environment perceive করে, multi-step actions পরিকল্পনা করে, tools ব্যবহার করে (web search, code execution, APIs), এবং minimal human intervention-এ goals অর্জন করে। vs Traditional chatbot: rule-based, single-turn, no memory, no tools।

mustKnow.en: Transfer learning: using a pre-trained model (trained on large dataset) and fine-tuning it on a specific smaller dataset. Saves training time and data. Example: fine-tuning BERT for Bangla sentiment analysis.
mustKnow.bn: Transfer learning: একটি pre-trained model (large dataset-এ trained) ব্যবহার করে এবং একটি নির্দিষ্ট smaller dataset-এ fine-tune করা। Training time ও data সাশ্রয় করে। উদাহরণ: Bangla sentiment analysis-এর জন্য BERT fine-tuning।

mustKnow.en: BNN (Biological Neural Network): the human brain's neural network — billions of neurons connected by synapses. ANN vs BNN: ANN has digital weights updated by backpropagation; BNN has analog synaptic strengths modified by learning (Hebbian plasticity). ANN is a simplified mathematical model of BNN.
mustKnow.bn: BNN (Biological Neural Network): মানব মস্তিষ্কের neural network — synapses দ্বারা সংযুক্ত billions of neurons। ANN vs BNN: ANN-এ backpropagation দ্বারা updated digital weights আছে; BNN-এ learning দ্বারা modified analog synaptic strengths আছে (Hebbian plasticity)। ANN হলো BNN-এর একটি simplified mathematical model।

mustKnow.en: Key ML metrics: Accuracy (correct/total), Precision (TP/(TP+FP)), Recall/Sensitivity (TP/(TP+FN)), F1-score (harmonic mean of precision and recall), AUC-ROC (area under ROC curve, classification quality).
mustKnow.bn: Key ML metrics: Accuracy (correct/total), Precision (TP/(TP+FP)), Recall/Sensitivity (TP/(TP+FN)), F1-score (precision ও recall-এর harmonic mean), AUC-ROC (ROC curve-এর নিচের area, classification quality)।

mustKnow.en: Overfitting vs Underfitting: Overfitting = model memorises training data but fails on new data (high variance, low bias). Underfitting = model too simple to capture patterns (high bias, low variance). Solutions: regularisation (L1/L2), dropout, cross-validation, more data.
mustKnow.bn: Overfitting vs Underfitting: Overfitting = model training data memorise করে কিন্তু নতুন data-তে ব্যর্থ হয় (high variance, low bias)। Underfitting = model patterns capture করতে অনেক simple (high bias, low variance)। Solutions: regularisation (L1/L2), dropout, cross-validation, আরো data।

question.en: A perceptron has inputs x1=1, x2=0 with weights w1=0.5, w2=0.3 and bias=0.1. Using sigmoid activation: what is the output?
question.bn: একটি perceptron-এ inputs x1=1, x2=0, weights w1=0.5, w2=0.3 এবং bias=0.1 আছে। Sigmoid activation ব্যবহার করে: output কী?

question.en: A fraud detection model has: TP=80, FP=20, FN=10, TN=890. Calculate Precision, Recall, and F1-score.
question.bn: একটি fraud detection model-এ: TP=80, FP=20, FN=10, TN=890। Precision, Recall এবং F1-score গণনা করুন।

traps.en: CNN is for images; RNN/LSTM is for sequences/time-series; Transformer is for both (and dominates). Exam question: 'Which algorithm is best for time-series?' — Answer: RNN (or LSTM). 'Which for image classification?' — CNN.
traps.bn: CNN images-এর জন্য; RNN/LSTM sequences/time-series-এর জন্য; Transformer উভয়ের জন্য (এবং dominant)। Exam question: 'Time-series-এর জন্য কোন algorithm সেরা?' — উত্তর: RNN (বা LSTM)। 'Image classification-এর জন্য কোনটি?' — CNN।

traps.en: Backpropagation uses all neural networks (MLP, CNN, RNN) — the answer to 'which ML model employs backpropagation' is 'All of the above' if options include MLP, CNN, RNN.
traps.bn: Backpropagation সব neural networks ব্যবহার করে (MLP, CNN, RNN) — 'কোন ML model backpropagation ব্যবহার করে' প্রশ্নের উত্তর হলো 'All of the above' যদি options-এ MLP, CNN, RNN থাকে।

traps.en: Generative AI is NOT just chatbots. It includes image generation (DALL-E, Midjourney), audio synthesis, video generation, code generation, drug discovery — anything that generates new content.
traps.bn: Generative AI শুধু chatbots নয়। এতে image generation (DALL-E, Midjourney), audio synthesis, video generation, code generation, drug discovery অন্তর্ভুক্ত — যেকোনো কিছু যা নতুন content তৈরি করে।

traps.en: ANN is NOT the same as BNN. ANN is a mathematical model inspired by BNN but much simpler. BNN uses electrochemical signals; ANN uses digital weights. ANN has no biological processes like neurotransmitters.
traps.bn: ANN BNN-এর মতো নয়। ANN হলো BNN দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত একটি mathematical model কিন্তু অনেক সহজ। BNN electrochemical signals ব্যবহার করে; ANN digital weights ব্যবহার করে। ANN-এ neurotransmitter-এর মতো কোনো biological process নেই।

traps.en: LLMs hallucinate — they generate confident-sounding wrong answers. This is NOT a bug but an emergent property of pattern-based generation without factual grounding. RAG and fine-tuning can reduce (not eliminate) hallucinations.
traps.bn: LLMs hallucinate করে — এগুলো confident-sounding ভুল উত্তর তৈরি করে। এটি কোনো bug নয় বরং factual grounding ছাড়া pattern-based generation-এর একটি emergent property। RAG ও fine-tuning hallucinations কমাতে পারে (eliminate করতে নয়)।

traps.en: Agentive AI ≠ Chatbot AI. Traditional chatbot: single-turn, rule/script-based, no memory, no tools. Agentive AI: multi-turn, goal-directed, persistent memory, uses tools (search, APIs, code execution), can plan and self-correct.
traps.bn: Agentive AI ≠ Chatbot AI। Traditional chatbot: single-turn, rule/script-based, no memory, no tools। Agentive AI: multi-turn, goal-directed, persistent memory, tools ব্যবহার করে (search, APIs, code execution), plan ও self-correct করতে পারে।

question.en: What is an Artificial Neural Network (ANN)? Explain its structure. What is an activation function and why is it needed in a Deep Neural Network?
question.bn: Artificial Neural Network (ANN) কী? এর structure ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Activation function কী এবং Deep Neural Network-এ কেন এটি প্রয়োজন?

en: ANN definition: computational model inspired by biological neural networks. Learns patterns from data.
Structure: Input layer (receives features), Hidden layer(s) (extracts patterns), Output layer (produces prediction). Each neuron connects to next layer with a weight.
Training: forward pass (compute output), calculate loss, backpropagation (compute gradients), gradient descent (update weights). Repeat until loss minimised.
Activation function: a non-linear function applied at each neuron output. Introduces non-linearity — without it, stacked layers are equivalent to a single linear transformation.
Common activation functions: Sigmoid (σ(x)=1/(1+e^-x)), ReLU (max(0,x)), Tanh, Softmax.
Usability: Sigmoid for binary output; ReLU for hidden layers (fast, no vanishing gradient); Softmax for multi-class output; Tanh for hidden layers when centered output needed.
ANN vs BNN: ANN = digital/mathematical, trained by backpropagation. BNN = biological/electrochemical, modified by experience (Hebbian learning).
bn: ANN সংজ্ঞা: biological neural networks দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত computational model। Data থেকে patterns শেখে।
Structure: Input layer (features গ্রহণ করে), Hidden layer(s) (patterns extract করে), Output layer (prediction তৈরি করে)। প্রতিটি neuron একটি weight দিয়ে next layer-এর সাথে সংযুক্ত।
Training: forward pass (output compute করে), loss calculate করে, backpropagation (gradients compute করে), gradient descent (weights update করে)। Loss minimised না হওয়া পর্যন্ত পুনরাবৃত্তি।
Activation function: প্রতিটি neuron output-এ applied non-linear function। Non-linearity introduce করে — এটি ছাড়া, stacked layers একটি single linear transformation-এর সমতুল্য।
Common activation functions: Sigmoid (σ(x)=1/(1+e^-x)), ReLU (max(0,x)), Tanh, Softmax।
Usability: binary output-এর জন্য Sigmoid; hidden layers-এর জন্য ReLU (দ্রুত, কোনো vanishing gradient নেই); multi-class output-এর জন্য Softmax; centered output প্রয়োজন হলে hidden layers-এর জন্য Tanh।
ANN vs BNN: ANN = digital/mathematical, backpropagation দ্বারা trained। BNN = biological/electrochemical, experience দ্বারা modified (Hebbian learning)।

5.en: ANN = layers (Input, Hidden, Output) with weighted connections. Activation function introduces non-linearity (e.g. ReLU, Sigmoid). Without it, deep networks collapse to one linear function.
5.bn: ANN = weighted connections সহ layers (Input, Hidden, Output)। Activation function non-linearity introduce করে (যেমন ReLU, Sigmoid)। এটি ছাড়া, deep networks একটি linear function-এ collapse হয়।

10.en: Full ANN definition + diagram of 3-layer network. Explain forward pass + backpropagation. List 4 activation functions with use cases. ANN vs BNN comparison. Application example in banking (fraud detection, credit scoring).
10.bn: পূর্ণ ANN সংজ্ঞা + 3-layer network-এর diagram। Forward pass + backpropagation ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Use case সহ 4টি activation function তালিকা করুন। ANN vs BNN তুলনা। Banking-এ application উদাহরণ (fraud detection, credit scoring)।

question.en: What is Generative AI? Explain Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications. How can Generative AI power a government citizen service chatbot?
question.bn: Generative AI কী? Large Language Models (LLMs) এবং এদের applications ব্যাখ্যা করুন। Government citizen service chatbot-কে Generative AI কীভাবে power করতে পারে?

en: Generative AI: AI that creates new content — text, images, audio, code, video. Core models: LLMs (text), GANs (images), Diffusion models (images/audio).
LLM: neural network (Transformer-based) trained on massive text. Understands context, generates coherent language. Examples: GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA.
LLM capabilities: question answering, summarisation, translation, code generation, creative writing, sentiment analysis.

Government citizen chatbot: RAG architecture — citizen asks question → LLM searches government knowledge base → generates grounded answer. Use cases: tax queries, policy lookup, form guidance, service status.

XAI for government AI: citizens need to understand why they got a specific answer or decision (accountability). LIME/SHAP explain which words/features influenced the answer. Transparency builds trust.
bn: Generative AI: নতুন content তৈরি করে এমন AI — text, images, audio, code, video। Core models: LLMs (text), GANs (images), Diffusion models (images/audio)।
LLM: massive text-এ trained neural network (Transformer-based)। Context বোঝে, coherent language তৈরি করে। উদাহরণ: GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA।
LLM capabilities: question answering, summarisation, translation, code generation, creative writing, sentiment analysis।

Government citizen chatbot: RAG architecture — নাগরিক প্রশ্ন করে → LLM government knowledge base অনুসন্ধান করে → grounded answer তৈরি করে। Use cases: কর query, policy lookup, ফর্ম গাইডেন্স, service status।

Government AI-এর জন্য XAI: নাগরিকদের বুঝতে হবে কেন তারা একটি নির্দিষ্ট উত্তর বা সিদ্ধান্ত পেয়েছে (accountability)। LIME/SHAP ব্যাখ্যা করে কোন words/features উত্তরকে প্রভাবিত করেছে। Transparency trust গড়ে তোলে।

5.en: Generative AI = creates new content. LLM = Transformer trained on massive text (GPT-4, Claude). Applications: chatbots, summarisation, translation. Government chatbot: RAG (retrieval + LLM) for accurate policy answers.
5.bn: Generative AI = নতুন content তৈরি করে। LLM = massive text-এ trained Transformer (GPT-4, Claude)। Applications: chatbots, summarisation, translation। Government chatbot: accurate policy answers-এর জন্য RAG (retrieval + LLM)।

10.en: Generative AI types (LLMs, GANs, Diffusion). LLM architecture (Transformer, training on internet-scale text, fine-tuning). Key capabilities. Citizen chatbot design with RAG. XAI techniques (LIME, SHAP). Challenges: hallucination, bias, privacy. Bangladesh government digital service example (a2i, e-service).
10.bn: Generative AI types (LLMs, GANs, Diffusion)। LLM architecture (Transformer, internet-scale text-এ training, fine-tuning)। Key capabilities। RAG সহ Citizen chatbot design। XAI techniques (LIME, SHAP)। Challenges: hallucination, bias, privacy। বাংলাদেশ government digital service উদাহরণ (a2i, e-service)।

question.en: What is Agentive AI? Compare it with traditional chatbot AI. What enables an AI agent to perform complex multi-step tasks autonomously?
question.bn: Agentive AI কী? Traditional chatbot AI-এর সাথে এটি তুলনা করুন। AI agent-কে স্বায়ত্তশাসিতভাবে complex multi-step tasks করতে কী সক্ষম করে?

en: Agentive AI: AI that autonomously plans and executes multi-step tasks toward a goal with minimal human intervention.

Components: Perception (input processing), Memory (short-term context + long-term storage), Planning (reasoning, task decomposition), Tool use (web search, code execution, APIs), Action (output/execution).
Traditional chatbot: rule-based or scripted, single Q&A turn, no memory across sessions, no tool use, cannot self-correct.
Agentive AI: goal-directed, multi-turn reasoning, persistent memory, uses external tools, can plan, reflect, retry.
What enables it: LLM as reasoning core + tool access (API, web, code) + memory systems + orchestration framework (LangChain, AutoGPT, LangGraph).
Examples: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, AutoGPT, AI research agents.
Risks: hallucination in chains, tool misuse, lack of accountability, infinite loops without stop conditions.
bn: Agentive AI: AI যা minimal human intervention-এ একটি goal-এর দিকে স্বায়ত্তশাসিতভাবে multi-step tasks পরিকল্পনা ও execute করে।

Components: Perception (input processing), Memory (short-term context + long-term storage), Planning (reasoning, task decomposition), Tool use (web search, code execution, APIs), Action (output/execution)।
Traditional chatbot: rule-based বা scripted, single Q&A turn, sessions-এ কোনো memory নেই, কোনো tool use নেই, self-correct করতে পারে না।
Agentive AI: goal-directed, multi-turn reasoning, persistent memory, external tools ব্যবহার করে, plan, reflect, retry করতে পারে।
যা সক্ষম করে: reasoning core হিসেবে LLM + tool access (API, web, code) + memory systems + orchestration framework (LangChain, AutoGPT, LangGraph)।
উদাহরণ: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, AutoGPT, AI research agents।
Risks: chains-এ hallucination, tool misuse, accountability-র অভাব, stop conditions ছাড়া infinite loops।

5.en: Agentive AI = autonomous multi-step goal planning with tools and memory. vs Traditional chatbot = single-turn, no memory, no tools. Key enabler: LLM + external tools + orchestration.
5.bn: Agentive AI = tools ও memory সহ autonomous multi-step goal planning। vs Traditional chatbot = single-turn, no memory, no tools। Key enabler: LLM + external tools + orchestration।

q.en: Which algorithm is best for time-series data in deep learning?
q.bn: Deep learning-এ time-series data-র জন্য কোন algorithm সেরা?

a.en: RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) and its variants LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) and GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) are best for time-series because they process sequential data with memory of previous steps. LSTM solves the vanishing gradient problem of basic RNNs. Transformers with positional encoding also excel at longer sequences. CNN can also process time-series via 1D convolutions but lacks natural sequential memory.
a.bn: RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) এবং এর variants LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) ও GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) time-series-এর জন্য সেরা কারণ এগুলো আগের steps-এর memory সহ sequential data process করে। LSTM basic RNNs-এর vanishing gradient problem সমাধান করে। Positional encoding সহ Transformers-ও longer sequences-এ ভালো। CNN 1D convolutions দিয়ে time-series process করতে পারে কিন্তু natural sequential memory নেই।

q.en: What is backpropagation and which neural networks use it?
q.bn: Backpropagation কী এবং কোন neural networks এটি ব্যবহার করে?

a.en: Backpropagation is the algorithm for training neural networks. It works backwards from the output: (1) compute the error (loss) at the output layer; (2) use the chain rule to calculate how each weight contributed to the error; (3) update weights using gradient descent to reduce the error. All neural networks that use differentiable layers use backpropagation: MLP, CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformer — all of the above.
a.bn: Backpropagation হলো neural networks training-এর algorithm। এটি output থেকে পেছনে কাজ করে: (1) output layer-এ error (loss) compute করে; (2) chain rule ব্যবহার করে প্রতিটি weight error-এ কতটুকু contribute করেছে তা calculate করে; (3) error কমাতে gradient descent ব্যবহার করে weights update করে। Differentiable layers ব্যবহার করা সব neural networks backpropagation ব্যবহার করে: MLP, CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformer — সব উপরের গুলো।

q.en: What is hallucination in AI, and how can it be reduced?
q.bn: AI-তে hallucination কী এবং এটি কীভাবে কমানো যায়?

a.en: AI hallucination is when a language model generates confident-sounding but factually incorrect or fabricated information. Causes: models learned to predict plausible-sounding text without grounding in facts. Examples: citing fake research papers, wrong dates, invented quotes. Mitigation: RAG (retrieve real documents before answering), fine-tuning on verified data, adding confidence indicators, fact-checking pipelines, human-in-the-loop review for high-stakes decisions.
a.bn: AI hallucination হলো যখন একটি language model confident-sounding কিন্তু factually incorrect বা fabricated তথ্য তৈরি করে। কারণ: models facts-এ grounding ছাড়া plausible-sounding text predict করতে শিখেছে। উদাহরণ: fake research papers cite করা, ভুল dates, invented quotes। Mitigation: RAG (উত্তর দেওয়ার আগে real documents retrieve করুন), verified data-তে fine-tuning, confidence indicators যোগ করা, fact-checking pipelines, high-stakes decisions-এর জন্য human-in-the-loop review।

q.en: What is the difference between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning?
q.bn: Supervised, unsupervised এবং reinforcement learning-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: Supervised learning: model trains on labelled data (input-output pairs). Goal: learn a mapping. Examples: spam detection, credit scoring. Unsupervised learning: model finds patterns in unlabelled data. Goal: discover structure. Examples: clustering customers, dimensionality reduction. Reinforcement learning: agent learns by trial and error — takes actions, receives rewards/penalties from environment. Goal: maximise cumulative reward. Examples: game playing (AlphaGo), robotics, trading algorithms.
a.bn: Supervised learning: model labelled data (input-output pairs)-এ train করে। লক্ষ্য: mapping শেখা। উদাহরণ: spam detection, credit scoring। Unsupervised learning: model unlabelled data-তে patterns খোঁজে। লক্ষ্য: structure আবিষ্কার করা। উদাহরণ: customers clustering, dimensionality reduction। Reinforcement learning: agent trial and error দ্বারা শেখে — actions নেয়, environment থেকে rewards/penalties পায়। লক্ষ্য: cumulative reward maximize করা। উদাহরণ: game playing (AlphaGo), robotics, trading algorithms।

q.en: What is Explainable AI (XAI) and why is it important for banking applications?
q.bn: Explainable AI (XAI) কী এবং banking applications-এর জন্য কেন এটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?

a.en: XAI = techniques to explain why an AI model made a specific decision, making it transparent and interpretable. Methods: LIME (explains individual predictions using local linear approximations), SHAP (assigns each feature a contribution score using game theory), saliency maps (highlights important input regions for image models). For banking: regulatory requirements demand explanations for credit decisions (Bangladesh Bank guidelines, EU's GDPR 'right to explanation'); a loan rejection must be explained to the applicant; fraud detection decisions need audit trails. Without XAI, banks cannot use black-box AI for high-stakes decisions.
a.bn: XAI = AI model কেন একটি নির্দিষ্ট decision নিয়েছে তা ব্যাখ্যা করার techniques, এটিকে transparent ও interpretable করে। Methods: LIME (local linear approximations ব্যবহার করে individual predictions ব্যাখ্যা করে), SHAP (game theory ব্যবহার করে প্রতিটি feature-কে একটি contribution score দেয়), saliency maps (image models-এর জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ input regions highlight করে)। Banking-এর জন্য: regulatory requirements credit decisions-এর ব্যাখ্যা দাবি করে (Bangladesh Bank guidelines, EU-র GDPR 'right to explanation'); loan rejection আবেদনকারীকে ব্যাখ্যা করতে হবে; fraud detection decisions-এর audit trails প্রয়োজন। XAI ছাড়া, ব্যাংকগুলো high-stakes decisions-এর জন্য black-box AI ব্যবহার করতে পারে না।

For exams: know ANN structure (layers, weights, activation), deep learning variants (CNN for images, RNN/LSTM for sequences, Transformer for modern NLP), backpropagation, and the ANN vs BNN distinction. Bank exams are starting to ask about neural networks and deep learning applications in finance.
overview.bn: Neural networks হলো আধুনিক AI-এর backbone। Exams-এর জন্য: ANN structure (layers, weights, activation), deep learning variants (images-এর জন্য CNN, sequences-এর জন্য RNN/LSTM, modern NLP-এর জন্য Transformer), backpropagation, এবং ANN vs BNN distinction জানুন। Bank exams finance-এ neural networks ও deep learning applications সম্পর্কে জিজ্ঞেস করতে শুরু করেছে।

points.en: CNN architecture (for images): Convolutional layer (feature maps using filters/kernels) → Activation (ReLU) → Pooling (max/avg pooling, reduces size) → Flatten → Fully connected → Output (Softmax for multiclass).
points.bn: CNN architecture (images-এর জন্য): Convolutional layer (filters/kernels ব্যবহার করে feature maps) → Activation (ReLU) → Pooling (max/avg pooling, size কমায়) → Flatten → Fully connected → Output (multiclass-এর জন্য Softmax)।

points.en: LSTM solves vanishing gradient: basic RNN loses information over long sequences. LSTM has gates: Forget gate (what to discard), Input gate (what to update), Output gate (what to output). This allows learning long-term dependencies.
points.bn: LSTM vanishing gradient সমাধান করে: basic RNN long sequences-এ information হারায়। LSTM-এ gates আছে: Forget gate (কী discard করতে হবে), Input gate (কী update করতে হবে), Output gate (কী output করতে হবে)। এটি long-term dependencies শিখতে দেয়।

points.en: Transformer self-attention: for each position, compute how much it should attend to every other position. Enables parallelism (unlike RNN which processes sequentially). Foundation of GPT, BERT, Claude, Gemini.
points.bn: Transformer self-attention: প্রতিটি position-এর জন্য, এটি অন্য প্রতিটি position-এ কতটুকু attend করা উচিত তা compute করে। Parallelism সক্ষম করে (RNN-এর মতো নয় যা sequentially process করে)। GPT, BERT, Claude, Gemini-এর foundation।

question.en: A bank wants to detect fraudulent transactions using ML. Which approach would you recommend?
question.bn: একটি ব্যাংক ML ব্যবহার করে fraudulent transactions detect করতে চায়। আপনি কোন approach সুপারিশ করবেন?

working.en: Use supervised learning with labelled historical transaction data (fraud=1, legitimate=0). Model options: Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) for tabular data, or ANN/DNN for complex patterns. Key features: amount, location, time, merchant, account history. Challenge: class imbalance (fraud is rare) — use SMOTE, class weights, or anomaly detection. Add XAI (SHAP) for regulatory compliance.
working.bn: Labelled historical transaction data (fraud=1, legitimate=0) সহ supervised learning ব্যবহার করুন। Model options: tabular data-র জন্য Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), বা complex patterns-এর জন্য ANN/DNN। Key features: amount, location, time, merchant, account history। Challenge: class imbalance (fraud বিরল) — SMOTE, class weights, বা anomaly detection ব্যবহার করুন। Regulatory compliance-এর জন্য XAI (SHAP) যোগ করুন।

answer.en: Supervised learning (XGBoost or ANN) with SMOTE for class imbalance and SHAP for explainability. Continuously retrain as fraud patterns evolve.
answer.bn: Class imbalance-এর জন্য SMOTE এবং explainability-র জন্য SHAP সহ Supervised learning (XGBoost বা ANN)। Fraud patterns evolve হওয়ার সাথে সাথে continuously retrain করুন।

points.en: Foundation models: large models pre-trained on diverse data that can be fine-tuned for specific tasks. BERT (encoder, classification, NER), GPT (decoder, generation), T5 (encoder-decoder, seq2seq tasks).
points.bn: Foundation models: diverse data-তে pre-trained large models যা specific tasks-এর জন্য fine-tune করা যায়। BERT (encoder, classification, NER), GPT (decoder, generation), T5 (encoder-decoder, seq2seq tasks)।

points.en: RAG architecture: 1. User query → 2. Retriever finds relevant docs from vector database (FAISS, Pinecone) → 3. Relevant docs + query → LLM → 4. Grounded answer. Reduces hallucination by providing factual context.
points.bn: RAG architecture: 1. User query → 2. Retriever vector database (FAISS, Pinecone) থেকে relevant docs খোঁজে → 3. Relevant docs + query → LLM → 4. Grounded answer। Factual context প্রদান করে hallucination কমায়।

points.en: Bangladesh AI applications: NLP for Bangla (BanglaBERT), government chatbots (a2i's Mygov), agricultural advisories, healthcare diagnosis, traffic management, digital inclusion for rural populations.
points.bn: বাংলাদেশ AI applications: Bangla-র জন্য NLP (BanglaBERT), government chatbots (a2i-এর Mygov), agricultural advisories, healthcare diagnosis, traffic management, rural populations-এর জন্য digital inclusion।

question.en: How can a Bangladeshi government agency use Generative AI to improve citizen services?
question.bn: একটি বাংলাদেশী government agency citizen services উন্নত করতে Generative AI কীভাবে ব্যবহার করতে পারে?

working.en: Use case: Bangladesh National Board of Revenue (NBR) tax helpdesk. Architecture: LLM (Bangla-capable, e.g. fine-tuned GPT) + RAG (retrieval from tax law database, circulars) + XAI (explain decisions). Chatbot answers tax queries in Bangla 24/7. Document summarisation for new policies. Automated form guidance. XAI ensures citizens can see why a ruling was made.
working.bn: Use case: বাংলাদেশ National Board of Revenue (NBR) tax helpdesk। Architecture: LLM (Bangla-capable, যেমন fine-tuned GPT) + RAG (tax law database, circulars থেকে retrieval) + XAI (decisions ব্যাখ্যা করুন)। Chatbot 24/7 Bangla-তে tax queries উত্তর দেয়। নতুন policies-এর জন্য Document summarisation। Automated form guidance। XAI নিশ্চিত করে নাগরিকরা দেখতে পারে কেন একটি ruling করা হয়েছিল।

answer.en: LLM + RAG chatbot for 24/7 Bangla tax queries, with XAI for transparent explanations, reducing call center load and improving rural access.
answer.bn: Transparent explanations-এর জন্য XAI সহ 24/7 Bangla tax queries-এর জন্য LLM + RAG chatbot, call center load কমায় এবং rural access উন্নত করে।

answer.en: Generative AI powers the citizen chatbot through: (1) LLM core (GPT/Claude/Gemini fine-tuned on government documents) generates natural language responses. (2) RAG pipeline: query → retrieve relevant policy docs → LLM answers based on retrieved context (reduces hallucination). (3) Document summarisation for policy briefs. XAI ensures transparency: LIME/SHAP shows which parts of policy text influenced the answer; audit logs track every response; confidence scores flag uncertain answers for human review. This makes the system accountable, transparent, and trustworthy for public use.
answer.bn: Generative AI citizen chatbot-কে power করে: (1) LLM core (government documents-এ fine-tuned GPT/Claude/Gemini) natural language responses তৈরি করে। (2) RAG pipeline: query → relevant policy docs retrieve করুন → retrieved context-এর উপর ভিত্তি করে LLM উত্তর দেয় (hallucination কমায়)। (3) Policy briefs-এর জন্য Document summarisation। XAI transparency নিশ্চিত করে: LIME/SHAP দেখায় policy text-এর কোন অংশ উত্তরকে প্রভাবিত করেছে; audit logs প্রতিটি response track করে; confidence scores অনিশ্চিত answers-কে human review-এর জন্য flag করে। এটি system-কে public use-এর জন্য accountable, transparent ও trustworthy করে।
